Upstream Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream operations stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture).   • Workstream leadership role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; responsible for end-to-end functional success of upstream operations use cases from discovery to deployment.

    • Validate analytics outputs, dashboards, and insights against operational realism and operating philosophies; drive iterative improvements with product/data teams.

    • Act as a trusted interface between upstream operations stakeholders and technical delivery teams; sustain credibility through practical workflow understanding.

    • Drive UAT planning and execution from a functional lens; confirm outputs are credible and usable for operations decision-making.

  • 810 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong upstream operations / field operations depth.

  • Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.

  • Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
  • Familiarity with upstream operations / production data sources and reporting environments used for operational performance tracking.

At GrowthX, our marketing strategy is built on two principles - discovery and trust. Content drives both. We're looking for a Junior Video Editor who wants to deeply learn the craft of long-form YouTube editing by working closely with senior editors, writers, and producers.

Where can this role evolve

  • You will start by assisting learning within existing IPs and formats.
  • Over time, you can grow into:
  • Owning full edits independently
  • Leading edits for specific shows or formats
  • Eventually helping launch new IPs and language channels (like Hindi)

  • 1-3 years of video editing experience.
  • At least 1 year of YouTube video editing experience (long-form preferred).
  • Comfortable with Premiere Pro (After Effects is a plus).
  • Basic understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual flow.
  • Strong willingness to learn, take feedback, and iterate fast.
  • Good taste - even if skills are still developing.
  • Has watched and studied high-quality YouTube content and wants to work in that ecosystem.

Engineer

Job type: Full Time

Department: Engineering

Work type: On-Site

Chennai; Bengaluru

Charles Proteus Steinmetz was once called in to solve a problem with a massive electrical generator that no one else could fix.

After studying the machine, he made a small chalk mark indicating exactly where the engineers needed to make the repair.

His bill

for making the chalk mark.
for knowing where to put it.

We re looking for that kind of engineer.

We call this role The Engineer.

Not because the problems are small, but because the best engineers have an unusual ability to cut through complexity, identify the one thing that matters, and solve problems others struggle with for weeks.

At Kula, you ll work on some of our hardest problems across AI and agentic systems. You ll build intelligent systems that dont just assist humans, but reason, take action, and autonomously complete meaningful work.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional technical judgment with extreme execution speed.

What youll do

You ll build AI systems and agents that operate in the real world.

You ll take ambitious, ambiguous problems and turn them into working products - fast.

You ll experiment with LLMs, agents, tools, memory, reasoning, evaluation, and orchestration to push the boundaries of what autonomous systems can reliably do.

You ll own problems end-to-end: understanding the problem, designing the system, writing the code, shipping it, observing how it behaves, and improving it.

You ll know when a problem needs a sophisticated new architecture and when it needs a chalk mark.

You might be the Engineer if...

You have an unusual ability to find the root cause of complex problems.

You can take something from an idea to production faster than most teams can schedule the kickoff meeting.

You have strong opinions, but youre willing to throw them away when the data proves you wrong.

You dont measure your impact by lines of code or hours spent. You measure it by problems solved.

You are deeply curious about AI and agentic systems and are constantly building, experimenting, and learning.

You thrive in ambiguity. Give you a well-defined ticket and youll execute it. Give you a seemingly impossible problem and youll come alive.

You care deeply about craft but you understand that speed is a feature.

The bar

Were not looking for someone who simply knows how to call an LLM API.

Were looking for someone who understands how to turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into reliable products that people can trust.

Someone who can move from first principles to prototype to production at exceptional speed.

Someone who can look at a problem everyone else thinks is complicated, make the right chalk mark, and say: "Fix it here."

If that sounds like you, wed love to meet you.

Job Summary

The postholder owns the licence, utilisation and Viva Insights data that underpins executive reporting, and run the Frontier Lab testing rhythm - scanning newly released AI features and products, prototyping them, and turning findings into monthly product notes and costed recommendations. The role is deliberately positioned between the technical and the business: enough depth to test a claim personally, enough stakeholder exposure to translate a business pain point into a feasible solution rather than a promise.

Responsibilities

  • Own the licence and user dataset end to end - sourcing, reconciling, de-duplicating and cleaning large HR, Microsoft 365 and tenant records to support Copilot allocation and rollout waves, keeping it audit-clean.
  • Build and run automated Viva Insights pipelines and reporting, replacing manual extraction and reconciliation.
  • Support the AI value measurement approach from data capture through to the benefit numbers reported to sponsors.
  • Maintain Cowork licence, cost and funding models, keeping assumptions documented, current and defensible to Finance, and build cost models for new capabilities so adoption decisions are commercially informed.
  • Design and build automations and prototypes using Python, Power Automate, Power Query, Copilot Studio, Dataverse and Microsoft Graph.
  • Work directly with teams to surface pain points, demonstrate practical solutions and unblock people testing new workflows.
  • Scan new AI product and feature releases continuously, with the Microsoft estate as the priority lane, and produce the first-cut monthly product note: what changed, what it means for WPP.
  • Run classification and initial triage into the Frontier Lab pipeline, escalating anything that trips a governance guardrail to the Governance Senior Associates front-door gate.
  • Execute pilots and user acceptance testing to a documented protocol, capturing the evidence behind each decision, and prototype hands-on before recommending - test the claim, then state what it will and will not do.

Requirements

  • Microsoft AZ-900 and DP-900 or equivalent cloud and data fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated ability to take messy, multi-source data - HR, tenant, licensing - and produce a reconciled dataset senior management can decide from.
  • Strong Excel and data-handling discipline; working Power BI capability or the aptitude to reach it quickly.
  • Analytical curiosity that goes past the surface: asks why this method, this platform, this formula, and can justify the answer.
  • Fast learner with a track record of absorbing new tooling and turning it into working output within weeks.
  • Problem framing from the stakeholders perspective - able to sit with a pain point and return options rather than obstacles.
  • Evidence-led communication: no capability claimed without having tested it.
  • Excellent written English; self-directed operating style with reliable overlap into London hours.
  • Comfortable moving between granular data work and a high-level decision conversation, and increasingly able to judge which the moment needs.

Who you are

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you

  • Passionate, inspired people - we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  • Scale and opportunity - we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  • Challenging and stimulating work - unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

Demand Generation & Pipeline
  • Own and operate MQL and SQL generation programs for international markets

GTM Planning & Execution
  • Develop and execute go-to-market plans for international market expansion and penetration
  • Translate market insights into campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, and activation plans

  • Track, measure, and report on funnel metrics, campaign performance, and marketing contribution to revenue
  • Use data to identify gaps, improve conversion rates, and prioritize marketing investment
  • Build dashboards and reporting structures that give the team and leadership clear visibility into performance

  • Manage and optimize the marketing tool stack, including HubSpot, to support campaign execution and lead management
  • Apply AI-powered tools and workflows to improve campaign efficiency and output quality
What Were Looking For
  • 5-8 years of experience in B2B marketing, with a clear focus on international markets
  • Demonstrated ability to generate and manage MQLs and SQLs across full-funnel programs
  • Experience owning GTM planning and end-to-end campaign execution
  • Experience planning and executing events, including field, regional, and virtual formats, as part of a demand generation mix
  • Experience running account-based marketing programs for target account segments
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot for campaign execution and lead management
  • Strong grasp of marketing analytics - comfortable working with funnel data and making decisions from it
  • Experience working in close alignment with sales and revenue teams
  • Hands-on familiarity with marketing tool stacks and AI-driven marketing workflows
Nice to Have
  • Experience in SaaS or technology-led B2B environments
  • Exposure to multiple international geographies (APAC, EMEA, or Americas)
What Makes You a Strong Fit
  • You approach marketing problems through the lens of pipeline and revenue, not just reach
  • You operate independently and hold yourself accountable to numbers
  • Youre comfortable moving between strategy and execution without losing track of either
  • You communicate clearly with sales and revenue counterparts and adapt to their feedback
  • You bring structure to ambiguous situations rather than waiting for clarity to arrive

International markets represent a significant and growing part of our business. This role directly shapes how efficiently we build pipeline in those markets - making it central to our revenue strategy. The work here influences sales velocity, market prioritization, and how we scale our GTM motion globally.
Why Join Us
  • Work on a product used by customers across global markets, with real international scope
  • Collaborate directly with sales and revenue leadership, with clear line of sight to business impact
  • Operate with meaningful ownership and room to shape how the marketing function evolves
  • Work in an environment that values data, speed, and execution over process
  • Grow with a team that is actively expanding its international footprint

The global financial system wasnt built for everyone. For millions of people, its reliance on interest (riba) creates a barrier to managing money and building wealth without compromising their values.

We are looking for an Accounts Officer - Treasury to join our Finance team and support the day-to-day management of payments, liquidity and treasury activities across Wahed s international entities.

Working closely with accountants and teams across the business, you will manage the end-to-end payment cycle, support cash flow and funding visibility, coordinate intercompany transactions and help resolve financial issues that could impact our operations.

  • Maintain clear visibility over upcoming financial obligations and proactively flag potential cash, payment or funding issues.
Financial Controls & Process Excellence
  • Help maintain strong financial governance across payment and treasury activities, ensuring transactions comply with internal policies and approval frameworks.
  • Work collaboratively with Finance and business stakeholders to understand payment requirements, improve workflows and strengthen the efficiency and scalability of treasury and AP processes.

  • Take ownership of ad hoc finance and treasury initiatives and contribute to broader Finance projects supporting Wahed s growth.

Within Analytics, we have well-established SME verticals (e.g., forecasting, sales analytics, commercial data solutions, data science, AI/ML solutions).

Trinity is seeking a talented, committed, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Enterprise Analytics Delivery (EAD) team as a Sr. Consultant. The EAD team acts as the pan-analytics backbone, orchestrating end-to-end execution, client partnership, and commercial growth for complex analytics programs. The Consultant is responsible for:
  • Developing analysis design for client problems, with responsibility for quality, timeliness, and business impact
  • Ensuring technical rigor across a range of analytics approaches (from descriptive and diagnostic analysis to advanced analytics and AI/ML)
The ideal candidate for this position will contribute to the firm s success through a strong work ethic, particularly in team settings, and can communicate with statisticians, data analysts, and business stakeholders alike. The Sr. Consultant should be able to independently run complex analyses, while guiding junior team members and bringing in relevant life sciences context.

This role is an important position within our team, engaging directly with global clients, leading internal teams, building capabilities and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and collaborating with
seamlessly with integrated Trinity teams across US, EU, and APAC.
Delivery Leadership
  • Lead specific analytical workstreams within a project, from problem framing and workplan development through analysis, synthesis, quality review, and final recommendations.
  • Understand and work with secondary RWE datasets such as claims, EMR, sales Data, Patient Level Datasets, and other real-world data sources to support commercial and analytical insights generation (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Flatiron, Definitive)
  • Partner with senior project leaders within Trinity to understand and refine the contextual why for business questions and structure the insights such that inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Be responsible for analysis execution using a selection of tools like Excel (along with Copilot), SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools
  • Identify gaps in analysis plan and data limitations as project progresses, and communicate effectively with project leaders to ensure resolution
  • Apply advanced data science methodologies and AI/ML models for client problems, support the design and deployment Trinity s technology solutions in client environments.
Mentoring and Coaching
  • Mentor and review the work of Associates, Associate Consultants and Consultants, providing feedback to strengthen problem solving, analytics execution, and client readiness.
  • Serve as direct people manager and own reporting lines; Coach team members to build stronger analytical, project management, and communication skills through day-to-day guidance and apprenticeship.

  • Gain methodological/ analytics approach expertise by aiding in proposal development as needed.
  • Contribute to pitch materials and case examples that showcase EAD capabilities across forecasting, brand analytics, RWE, access analytics, sales analytics, advanced modeling, AI/ML, and AI-enabled delivery.

  • Education: Bachelors degree in a quantitative, technical, scientific, business, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of direct work experience in a related field (life sciences consulting, biopharma analytics, and/or general consulting).
Other Important Skills:
  • Experience in life sciences, including healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or medtech business questions and data.
  • Strong proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, R, or Python, with the ability to execute and review complex analyses.
  • Experience across commercial, market, customer, and evidence-generation use cases, including
forecasting, segmentation, sales or performance analytics, access analytics, and advanced modeling.

  • Experience managing and mentoring junior team members in a professional services, consulting, or analytics environment.
  • Knowledge of implementing custom AI Agents is a plus.

Thomson Reuters is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join the General Counsel s Office team supporting the Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa region (Asia and Emerging Markets, AEM).

The role will work closely with colleagues across legal, compliance, privacy, product and business teams globally.

Commercial Contracting
  • Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including: SaaS and software licence agreements, Data and content licensing agreements, Professional services agreements, NDAs, Partnership agreements (reseller, channel, alliances, technology integrations) and AI-related commercial arrangements.

  • Be comfortable advising on legal, contractual and regulatory issues relating to AI-enabled products and services.

Regulatory, Compliance and Risk Management
  • Help to identify, assess and mitigate legal and regulatory risks associated with business initiatives.
  • Together with SMEs, provide advice on: Privacy and data protection, Anti-corruption and compliance issues, governance obligations and consumer and commercial law matters
  • Develop and deliver legal training and guidance materials for business stakeholders.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving legal and regulatory developments across the region.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • The role will have a primary focus on the Middle East and Africa, but must be comfortable to flex and support colleagues across the AEM region during team absences and critical business windows.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Sales, Professional Services, Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, Compliance, GCO and Leadership teams.
  • Collaborate with lawyers and subject matter experts across Thomson Reuters globally.
  • Contribute to process improvements, template development, playbooks and legal operations initiatives designed to improve efficiency and consistency.

About Metayb
Metayb is a fast-growing AI-led technology services and transformation company empowering organizations to thrive in the digital-first era. We work across the CPG and retail value chain, helping organizations transform their businesses through technology, automation, data, and AI.
Our expertise spans Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Finance, and Supply Chain Services. We bring deep practitioner experience across source-to-pay, demand planning and management, distribution, and the marketing engines that support the broader value chain.

Headquartered in Chennai, with the Middle East and Africa as our core client markets and a growing presence in Southeast Asia, Metayb is building towards a truly global platform. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are expanding beyond organic growth through a disciplined acquisition programme focused on identifying and acquiring founder-led technology services businesses. Alongside our M&A agenda, we are expanding our senior leadership team, market presence, and strategic partnerships.

Role Overview
As an Investment Associate, you will play a central role in driving Metayb s M&A and growth programme. This is an execution-focused role rather than a research position. You will work directly with the CEO and senior leadership across live transactions, supporting the journey from target identification and screening through valuation, due diligence, negotiations, and closing.

The role combines financial analysis, transaction execution, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and strong process discipline. You will be expected to keep multiple deal workstreams moving, ensure nothing falls through the cracks, and progressively take greater ownership of transactions and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities 1. Deal Analysis & Valuation
  • Evaluate acquisition targets and assess their financial, commercial, and strategic attractiveness.
  • Analyse normalised earnings, revenue quality, growth, margins, cash flows, and other key financial metrics.
  • Assess FX-adjusted growth and identify appropriate adjustments to reported financial performance.
  • Build and maintain valuation models using relevant valuation methodologies and market comparables.
  • Reconcile seller-provided information with audited financial statements and underlying business performance.
  • Identify key assumptions, risks, inconsistencies, and value drivers within target businesses.
  • Prepare clear and concise investment screening materials and decision-ready analysis for senior leadership.
2. Transaction Execution & Process Management
  • Support transactions across screening, NDA, LOI, due diligence, negotiations, and definitive documentation.
  • Coordinate information requests, data-room activities, management meetings, and transaction-related follow-ups.
  • Maintain detailed action trackers and ensure all open items are followed through to closure.
  • Coordinate with founders, auditors, lawyers, bankers, advisors, and internal stakeholders throughout the transaction.
  • Prepare meeting notes, action items, status updates, and next-step summaries.
  • Proactively identify delays, dependencies, and risks that could impact transaction timelines.
3. M&A Pipeline Management
  • Maintain the M&A pipeline and transaction trackers as the single source of truth for acquisition activity.
  • Track targets, transaction stages, open items, commitments, and follow-ups accurately and consistently.
  • Ensure senior leadership has clear visibility into the status of every active transaction.
  • Manage multiple transaction workstreams simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Continuously improve processes and tracking mechanisms to strengthen transaction execution.
4. Strategic & Commercial Analysis

Tools & Workflow
We are tool-agnostic.
We do not require strong proficiency in any particular design software.

What matters to us is:
Your thinking Your creative direction Your execution The final outcome.
The ability to learn and adapt to new tools is more important than expertise in a specific software.
AI & Emerging Creative Tools
  • Use AI and emerging creative technologies where they can improve ideation, exploration, experimentation, or productivity.
  • Know how to combine AI-assisted workflows with human creative judgement.
  • Maintain originality, quality, brand consistency, and design intent when using AI.
  • Be willing to experiment with new creative technologies and workflows.
Portfolio
A strong portfolio is mandatory.
We are particularly interested in portfolios that demonstrate:
  • Strong creative concepts
  • Original visual thinking
  • Visual storytelling
  • Branding and identity
  • Digital experiences
  • UX/design thinking
  • Campaign or communication design
  • Ability to solve different kinds of creative problems
  • Strong attention to detail and quality of execution
We want to understand how you think , not just how polished your final designs looks.

Qualification
  • 3+ years of professional experience in graphic/visual design or a related creative role.
  • Degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

jobDescription:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the worlds leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By Connecting Convenience across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
Role Overview:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer II with strong hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and container technologies.
The DevOps Engineer II will be responsible for implementing and supporting DevOps solutions, maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure and operational activities, troubleshooting issues, and supporting application teams across multiple environments.
The ideal candidate should be able to work independently on well-defined requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to improving existing DevOps frameworks and standards.
Key Responsibilities:
CI/CD:
  • Build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Configure pipelines for application build, testing, packaging, and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures.
  • Integrate unit testing, code-quality checks, security scanning, and other required quality gates.
  • Work with existing shared pipeline libraries, templates, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual deployment activities through automation.
  • Support application deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments.
AWS & Cloud Infrastructure:
  • Provision and support infrastructure primarily in AWS.
  • Work with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, EKS, IAM, VPC, ALB, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, and SSM.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, IAM, DNS, and application connectivity issues.
  • Support infrastructure changes across multiple environments.
  • Follow established cloud architecture, security, tagging, and operational standards.
Infrastructure as Code:
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Modify and enhance existing Terraform modules.
  • Create Terraform configurations for new infrastructure requirements.
  • Troubleshoot Terraform plan and apply failures.
  • Manage environment-specific Terraform configurations.
  • Participate in peer reviews of Infrastructure as Code changes.
  • Follow established Terraform and IaC standards.
Automation & Configuration Management:
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for server configuration and application deployment.
  • Automate operational activities using Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Identify repetitive manual tasks and automate them.
  • Maintain and improve existing automation.
  • Troubleshoot automation failures and implement permanent fixes where possible.
Containers & Kubernetes:
  • Build and troubleshoot Docker containers.
  • Deploy and support applications running on Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Work with Kubernetes resources including:
  • Pods
  • Deployments
  • Services
  • ConfigMaps
  • Secrets
  • Ingress
  • Persistent storage
  • Work with Helm charts for application deployment and configuration.
  • Troubleshoot container startup, deployment, networking, configuration, and resource issues.
  • Basic experience with ECS/Fargate is beneficial.
Monitoring & Troubleshooting:
  • Monitor infrastructure and application health using tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or similar platforms.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment, and application environment issues.
  • Investigate alerts and operational incidents.
  • Participate in root cause analysis.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend automation or permanent fixes.
  • Support lower and production environments as required.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation where applicable.
Platform & Developer Enablement:
  • Support Engineering teams in adopting established DevOps and platform standards.
  • Contribute to reusable CI/CD, infrastructure, and automation solutions.
  • Help automate common Engineering requests.
  • Contribute to developer self-service capabilities.
  • Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Share technical knowledge with team members.
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS.
  • Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience building and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience with Ansible or similar configuration-management tools.
  • Working experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of Helm.
  • Experience with Git and pull-request-based development workflows.
  • Scripting experience using at least one of: PowerShell, Bash and Python.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration.
  • Understanding of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, Load balancers, Firewalls/Security Groups, VPCs/Subnets and Routing.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot common infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment issues.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with AWS EKS, ECS, or Fargate.
  • Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD.
  • Experience with SonarQube, Trivy, or other security/code-quality tools.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.
  • AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, or other relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Key Competencies:
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Automation-first mindset.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned technical requirements.
  • Good understanding of DevOps practices and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering, Platform, CloudOps, Security, and other teams.
  • Ability to identify recurring problems and contribute to permanent solutions.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve technical skills.
Level II Expectations
A DevOps Engineer II should be able to:
  • Independently complete well-defined DevOps tasks.
  • Build and modify CI/CD pipelines using established frameworks.
  • Provision and modify AWS infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible automation.
  • Deploy and troubleshoot containerized workloads.
  • Troubleshoot common infrastructure, CI/CD, and deployment issues.
  • Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them.
  • Follow established architecture, security, and engineering standards.
  • Contribute improvements to existing frameworks and reusable solutions.
  • Support and share knowledge with junior team members.
Behavioral Competencies
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Manages Complexity
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Balances Stakeholders
  • Collaborates Effectively
PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobDescription:
Job Summary
NCS Pte Ltd is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on technical depth and independent problem-solving ability to support a large-scale data platform migration engagement with Singtel. The role involves reviewing vendor-produced source-to-target mappings, validating data schema designs, and building robust ETL pipelines and data mart layers on Databricks (Azure) to power downstream Power BI dashboards and scheduled reporting.
The successful candidate will work directly within the NCS delivery team alongside Singtel stakeholders and the incumbent vendor, taking full ownership of the data engineering workstream - from schema validation through pipeline development, data quality assurance, and go-live support.
Key Responsibilities
Schema Review & Data Validation
Review and validate design spec for data marts to be developed in Databricks.
Assess the optimized data schema proposed by the vendor to confirm completeness, correctness of data types, and alignment with business requirements.
Cross-reference the backend queries of Cognos reports against the proposed schema to ensure all required tables and fields are included.
Identify gaps, redundancies, and inconsistencies; document findings and work collaboratively with the vendor and Singtel teams to resolve them.
ETL Pipeline Development
Design and build scalable, optimized ETL pipelines in Databricks using PySpark and SQL to ingest, transform, and load data.
Develop aggregated views and data mart layers to serve as the analytical foundation for Power BI dashboards and Databricks scheduled reports.
Implement robust error handling, logging, data validation checks, and reconciliation frameworks across all pipeline stages.
Data Architecture & Goverce
Apply medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold) principles to organize data layers within Databricks Unity Catalog.
Maintain and contribute to the data catalogue, data dictionary, business glossary, and technical data lineage documentation.
Ensure data modelling standards, naming conventions, and data type conversion guidelines are adhered to across all deliverables.
AI-Accelerated Delivery
Leverage AI-powered developer tools/features (e.g., Databricks Assistant, Genie, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate ETL code generation, schema analysis, and validation tasks.
Champion automation-first practices within the team; identify repetitive tasks suitable for AI augmentation and implement accordingly.
Stakeholder & Vendor Engagement
Actively participate in client workshops, technical reviews, and sprint ceremonies with Singtel stakeholders and the platform vendor.
Proactively communicate risks, propose mitigations, and escalate blockers with a solutions-focused mindset.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, status reports, and delivery artifacts to the standard expected in a large enterprise engagement.
Mandatory Skills & Experience
Core Technical Proficiency
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Python, and PySpark for data transformation and pipeline development.
Hands-on production experience with Databricks: ETL pipeline build, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and Databricks SQL.
Hands-on experience with Oracle (on-premises) - including reading Oracle schemas, understanding execution plans, and migrating Oracle SQL to Spark SQL.
Data Engineering Fundamentals
Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT development patterns, incremental loading, SCD handling, and change data capture.
Experience with data validation frameworks, reconciliation strategies, and exception/error handling at scale.
Solid understanding of data modelling (relational, dimensional, and flat/wide schemas) and data architecture patterns (medallion, star schema, data vault).
Practical experience creating and maintaining source-to-target mapping documents, data dictionaries, and business glossaries.
Knowledge of data type conversion challenges between Oracle and Spark/Databricks environments.
AI & Automation Tools
Ability to critically evaluate and refine AI-generated code for production-quality data pipelines.
Experience Level
Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in data engineering roles.
Prior experience in a data platform migration engagement (on-premises to cloud) is strongly preferred.
Professional & Technical Certifications
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional (preferred)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (preferred)
Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) (advantageous)
Oracle Database SQL Certified Associate (advantageous)
Any recognized AI/ML certification (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer) (advantageous)
Good to Have Skills
Familiarity with Cognos report structures and backend SQL, enabling effective analysis of report dependencies.
Experience with Power BI data models (DirectQuery, import, composite) to support collaboration with the BI team.
Knowledge of Apache Spark performance tuning, query optimization, and cluster configuration on Databricks.
Exposure to data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Databricks Delta Live Tables constraints).
Understanding of DevOps/DataOps practices: Git branching, CI/CD pipelines for data, and automated testing of data pipelines.
Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery teams in a client-facing consulting environment.
Familiarity with Singtels data ecosystem or telco industry data models is an advantage.
Soft & Interpersonal Skills
Strong technical and logical reasoning skills - ability to independently understand complex work scopes, identify the right approach, and articulate trade-offs clearly.
Ownership and accountability mindset - takes responsibility for deliverable quality and timelines without requiring close supervision.
Proactive risk identification - surfaces risks early, proposes practical mitigations, and drives resolution.
Positive, can-do attitude - maintains constructive energy under pressure and in ambiguous situations.
Client stakeholder management - communicates professionally with Singtel business and technical stakeholders at various levels.
Vendor collaboration - works constructively with the incumbent platform vendor, balancing assertiveness with diplomacy.
Strong team player - contributes to team knowledge sharing, pair reviews, and collective problem-solving.
Clear written and verbal communication - able to produce high-quality technical documentation and present findings concisely.

About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( AgriLokal )
  • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

descriptionFromApi:
The role
Most companies that say they "build AI" are wiring API calls to somebody elses model. We do that too, where it makes sense. But the interesting problems at Innovaccer are the ones a general-purpose model cannot solve: reasoning over a patient record that spans eleven systems and thirty years, deciding whether a prior authorization meets a payer policy that changed last Tuesday, extracting a diagnosis code with an accuracy bar where being wrong has consequences.
Those problems need models we train, evaluate, and own.
This team builds them. You will work on post-training and domain adaptation of language models from a few billion parameters up to the hundreds of billions, agent architectures that hold up over long horizons, evaluation systems that tell the truth, and the inference infrastructure that gets all of it running under real latency and cost budgets. You will read papers on Monday and have something running by Friday. You will also be the person who takes it to production, because we do not have a research group that throws prototypes over a wall.
Innovaccer is committing $250M over three years to its agentic AI platform. This team is where a meaningful share of that goes.
What you will work on
Nobody does all of this. You go deep on one or two areas and stay conversant in the rest.
Building the model systems behind entire products
Our products are not one model with a prompt in front of it. Flow, our revenue cycle platform, runs document understanding, policy retrieval and reasoning, code assignment, denial prediction, and drafting, each with different accuracy, latency, and cost requirements. Somebody has to design the whole thing and make the pieces work together.
That is a core part of this job. You will own the model portfolio behind a product surface, which means:
  • Fine-tuning across the full size range. Small language models in the 1B to 8B range for high-volume, latency-sensitive, cost-constrained tasks. Medium models in the 8B to 70B range where the reasoning gets harder. Large open-weight models from 100B into the hundreds of billions where the task genuinely demands frontier capability. Knowing which tier a task actually needs is a judgment call worth a lot of money, and getting it wrong in either direction is expensive.
  • Composing them into a system. Routing and cascades, small models handling the common case with escalation to larger ones, retrieval and tool layers, structured decoding, verifier models checking generator output, and the fallback paths for when a component fails.
  • Owning it in production. Versioning across a model fleet, shadow deployment, staged rollout, drift detection, retraining triggers, and the regression suite that runs before anything ships.
  • Holding a product-level accuracy bar, not a per-model benchmark score. A pipeline of individually good models can still produce a bad product, and finding out why is your problem.
Post-training at scale
Domain adaptation of open-weight models to clinical, claims, and payer-policy data, across the full size range described above.
  • Supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization (DPO, GRPO, and what replaces them), and RL with verifiable rewards on tasks where correctness is machine-checkable.
  • Continued pretraining and domain-adaptive pretraining where the vocabulary and distribution shift enough to justify it.
  • Parameter-efficient methods where they suffice, full fine-tuning where they do not, and the experimental discipline to know which case you are in.
  • Distillation from large teachers into small models that hold the accuracy bar at a fraction of the serving cost.
  • Reward modeling, and the harder problem of specifying reward on tasks where clinical correctness is contested.
Running these jobs is its own discipline. You will work with multi-node training on hundreds of GPUs: FSDP and DeepSpeed, tensor and pipeline and sequence parallelism, activation checkpointing, mixed precision and its failure modes, checkpoint and resume strategy, throughput and MFU tuning, and diagnosing the loss spike at hour 40 of a run that cost real money. Experience keeping a large distributed run healthy is a specific skill and we are hiring for it explicitly.
Data: raw to training-ready
This is where most of the actual gain comes from, and it is the part most candidates undersell.
Healthcare data does not arrive as a dataset. It arrives as HL7 feeds, FHIR bundles, claims files, PDFs, scanned faxes, free-text notes with inconsistent structure, and payer policy documents that change without notice. Turning that into a training corpus is a research problem in its own right.
  • Building the pipelines that take raw, messy, multi-format healthcare data to deduplicated, decontaminated, quality-filtered, PHI-safe training data.
  • Data mixture design and the experiments that justify it. Ablations on what to include, at what ratio, and at what stage of training.
  • Synthetic data generation, self-instruct and teacher-model pipelines, rejection sampling, and the quality controls that keep synthetic data from quietly poisoning a run.
  • Annotation strategy with clinical and coding experts on staff: what to label, how to measure inter-annotator agreement, and when expert disagreement means your task definition is wrong rather than your labelers.
  • Decontamination against your own eval sets, done properly, before someone else finds the leak.
Agents and reasoning systems
Multi-step agents that complete real operational work rather than producing suggestions: submitting an authorization, closing a care gap, resolving a denial. Tool use, planning, memory, and recovery from failure. Research questions here are open: how to train agentic behavior rather than prompt it, how to do credit assignment over long trajectories, how to make an agent recognize it is failing and stop. The hard part is reliability over long horizons when every intermediate step can go wrong, and the failure modes are not amusing.
Evaluation, safety, and guardrails
Eval is a research function here, not a QA step.
  • Designing task-specific benchmarks where no public benchmark exists, which in clinical operations is most of the time.
  • LLM-as-judge calibration against clinical expert labels, and knowing when the judge is the thing that is broken.
  • Statistical rigor: confidence intervals on eval results, sample size, and resisting the pull of a number that looks good.
  • PHI detection and redaction, output guardrails, and the audit trails that let a health system trust an autonomous workflow. Every agent we ship keeps a human in the loop somewhere, and part of this work is deciding where.
Inference and production ML
Serving small and large models efficiently: quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV-cache strategy, GPU utilization. Latency and cost budgets are real constraints, not afterthoughts. Building the training and deployment pipelines that let the team go from a notebook to a production endpoint in days.
What we expect from everyone in this role
  • You take an idea from paper to prototype to production. If you have only ever done one of those three, this role will stretch you, and we are fine with that if the rest is strong.
  • You can build the model layer of a real product, not just a model. That means choosing model sizes, composing several models into a working system, and holding a product-level accuracy bar.
  • You write real code. Python fluently, PyTorch fluently, and enough systems sense to know why your training run is slow.
  • You design experiments. You state the hypothesis, run the ablation, and report the result that disagrees with you.
  • You measure things. You are suspicious of results that look good, and you build the eval before you build the model.
  • You read current research and can tell the difference between a technique that will hold up and one that will not.
  • You explain your work to people who are not AI engineers, including clinicians and operators who will tell you when your output is wrong.
Qualifications by level AI Engineer / AI Researcher
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. Exceptional BS candidates with substantial research or open-source work will be considered.
  • Depth beyond coursework: first-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or similar; meaningful open-source ML contributions; a research internship at an AI lab; or models you trained and shipped that people actually used.
  • You have fine-tuned an open-weight model yourself, understand the difference between parameter-efficient and full fine-tuning, and can explain why you chose one.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch. Familiarity with the current training and serving stack (HuggingFace, FSDP or DeepSpeed, vLLM or SGLang, or equivalents).
  • Some exposure to multi-GPU training, even at lab scale. You should know what a sharding strategy is and why it matters.
  • Evidence you can finish things.
Senior AI Engineer / Senior AI Researcher
Everything above, plus:
  • You have post-trained models that ran in production and you know what broke.
  • You have built the model layer behind a real product feature, including fine-tuning at more than one model size and composing multiple models into a system that met a production accuracy and latency bar.
  • Hands-on multi-node training experience, tens of GPUs at minimum, on models in the tens of billions of parameters or larger.
  • You have built or substantially owned a data pipeline that fed a real training run, including the unglamorous parts: dedup, filtering, decontamination, format normalization.
  • You can scope an ambiguous problem into a plan and tell the difference between a research question and an engineering task.
  • Mentoring or setting direction for other engineers is a plus and will matter more as the team grows.
Things that stand out
  • Public artifacts: papers, repos, model weights, technical reports, benchmark contributions.
  • You have shipped a product where intelligence was the product, and can walk through every model decision you made and what you would do differently.
  • Reinforcement learning applied to language models, done rather than read about.
  • Work on evaluation methodology, which is underrated and hard to hire for.
  • Data-centric research: you can point to a gain that came from the corpus rather than the architecture.
  • Systems background: CUDA, NCCL and collective communication tuning, distributed training frameworks, compiler or kernel work.
  • You have built something in a regulated or high-stakes domain and understand why "usually right" is not a spec.
Why this team
Model quality is not the bottleneck in healthcare AI. Context is. Innovaccer has spent over a decade building the data foundation underneath American healthcare: clinical, claims, financial, and operational data unified across Millions of patient lives. That foundation is Gravity, our Healthcare Autonomy Platform , and it is what our agent families run on across revenue cycle, population health, payer risk and quality, and patient access.
What that means for you concretely:
  • Training data most labs cannot get. Real longitudinal clinical and claims data at scale, under strict governance, for training and evaluation.
  • Compute for real runs. Budgeted for multi-hundred-GPU post-training, not just inference.
  • Ground truth on tap. Clinical and coding experts on staff who will label your data and tell you when your model is wrong.
  • Products waiting for your models. Four agent families already in production at enterprise health systems and payers. What you train ships into, not into a demo environment.
  • A team is being built now. This group defines the in-house modeling function. You will shape what it becomes rather than inherit it.
Innovaccer is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on the quality of their thinking and their work.
